brief.goal: Synchronize the project startup protocol and solution design standard with current static project truth.

allowed_writes: The two scoped static documentation files
Task, Context Manifest and project control-plane updates
forbidden_actions: runtime, API, frontend, database schema or View changes
all external platform reads and writes
resource preparation, create, retry, budget, bid or OAuth actions
persisting dynamic identifiers, credentials, complete touchpoint URLs or raw platform payloads
validation_plan: compare against current logic and data/report contracts
stop_conditions: synchronization requires runtime or database changes
a required rule conflicts with current logic or data/report contracts
any step requires platform or business-fact mutation

validation: current logic and data/report contract comparison
Task/Manifest JSON and reference path validation
Case/Job, Gate, Plan and readback rule scan
